notes.title: Minor Update: Localization & Exit Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hello, brave souls who have chosen to sail the sea![/p][p][b]This small update brings community-suggested fixes to improve your experience.[/b] [b]Credits and language have been polished, and the game will no longer close at the end of your journey.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and support! 🐟[/p]
